thought.text: `vm.max_map_count` is already 1048576 (≥ required 262144). Now start Elasticsearch as a daemon.

reasoning_content:
`vm.max_map_count` is already at 1048576, which is well above the minimum of 262144. Good.

Next, start Elasticsearch as the elastic user in the background (as a daemon).

action.command: cd /opt/es && nohup su -s /bin/bash elastic -c "ES_JAVA_OPTS='-Xms1g -Xmx1g' /opt/es/bin/elasticsearch -d -p /var/run/elasticsearch.pid" > /var/log/es_start.log 2>&1; echo "start exit: $?"; cat /var/log/es_start.log; sleep 8; tail -5 /opt/es/logs/index-data-explorer.log 2>/dev/null

tool_call.name: terminal
